import os

def is_default(port: int) -> bool:

pr_metadata.title: Configurable default port check

labels.defect: Type confusion: PORT is now a str when the env var is set (or int when absent), so is_default('8080') compares str to int
labels.evidence: Reproducible: PORT=8080 in the environment → PORT is '8080' (str) and is_default(8080) returns False; the not-a-default banner prints on the default port.
